description: U.S. Climate Outlooks is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Weather Service, Climate Prediction Center. Unlike traditional weather forecasts that predict daily temperatures and precipitation amounts for an area, climate outlooks indicate how confident forecasters are that upcoming temperature and precipitation conditions will be above or below what's normal for their region over the period of the outlook. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
